description: Skyway Air support documentation and staff discussion about changing a booking.

files.description: A Confluence page in the support-playbooks space for support agents about changing a booking, last updated between 2025-05-01 and 2025-12-15. It must contain these sentences word for word: "Standard changes cost $50 per passenger plus the fare difference.". Write it plainly as a normal, current doc of its time. Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not mention lithium, power bank, power banks, watt-hour, watt-hours.
